items.sentence: Software already runs much of the market, but running is by no means the same as answering for it. Were many firms to rely on one model, their errors would be likely to move in lockstep, and that model could become a single point of failure. Most participants in the IMF's outreach want a human in the loop, partly because accountability presupposes someone who can be asked why. A token counts as money only while a community keeps accepting it, so whether a machine-only token is money hinges on whether machines can do the accepting, and what remains to be seen is whether they ever could. Standard contracts cut both ways: they make checking easier, yet they make firms more alike. We should not read too much into a toy with ten banks, with the caveat that it shows what could happen, not what will.
